rulings.rationale: Reviewer 2's rejection is well-supported by the current codebase. The design ambiguity raised by the amendment is already thoroughly documented and tracked: (1) docs/ROUTING.md:144 explicitly states 'Current TrimPlants { fraction } today behaves like TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings' and that 'Future action work should split the current behavior into the two explicit variants above' (TrimPlantsAndExport vs TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings); (2) docs/scientific_inventory.md:226 lists this as known design debt referencing tanksim-6e5.3.1; (3) .beads/issues.jsonl contains tanksim-6e5.3.5 which is a fully specified bead to split trim_plants into export-vs-leave-cuttings with detailed acceptance criteria and test scenarios. The amendment raises a valid observation but adds no new information — the team has already made the deliberate design decision, documented it, and planned the fix. Accepting this amendment would treat already-tracked, intentionally-deferred work as a new finding.

payload.summary: The sole disputed amendment (fr-6-2cbef174) regarding trim_plants routing biomass to fine_detritus is rejected. While the observation is technically accurate, the codebase already comprehensively documents this as intentional current behavior (ROUTING.md:144), lists it as known design debt (scientific_inventory.md:226), and has a fully-specified backlog item (tanksim-6e5.3.5) to split the action into TrimPlantsAndExport vs TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings. The implementation, documentation, and backlog are aligned — this is not a new finding requiring action.
